
Matching Modules
================

   #  Name                                Disclosure Date  Rank    Check  Description
   -  ----                                ---------------  ----    -----  -----------
   0  auxiliary/admin/ldap/bad_successor  2025-05-21       normal  Yes    BadSuccessor: dMSA abuse to Escalate Privileges in Windows Active Directory
   1    \_ action: CREATE_DMSA            .                .       .      Create a dMSA account which impersonates a high privilege user
   2    \_ action: GET_TICKET             .                .       .      Requests a series of tickets to give the user a ticket which can be used in the context of whomst the dMSA account impersonates

Interact with a module by name or index. For example info 2, use 2 or use auxiliary/admin/ldap/bad_successor
After interacting with a module you can manually set a ACTION with set ACTION 'GET_TICKET'
